about: The record holds a line for benign prostatic hyperplasia with urinary symptoms. The same line records "Clinician's assessment of prostate surgery: unnecessary". Finasteride is supplied every month but no alpha-1 blocker such as tamsulosin or silodosin is supplied.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about "Lower urinary tract symptoms due to benign prostate enlargement". The later Proscar 5 mg supplies suggest this condition and no selective alpha-1 blocker is supplied. The earlier Finapen brand alone does not establish prostate treatment.

The record holds a line for benign prostatic hyperplasia with urinary symptoms and "Clinician's assessment of prostate surgery: unnecessary". Tamsulosin (Flomaxtra) is supplied every month to the end of the history, so the alpha-1 blocker is there.
